Required topics

What Does a CTEC 20 Hour Course Cover?

The required hours are divided into four subject areas. Individual course syllabi differ, so review the school’s outline if you want more emphasis on a particular topic.

SubjectHoursFocus
Federal tax law10Federal tax subjects relevant to preparing returns
Federal tax law updates3Changes and developments in federal taxation
Ethics2Professional responsibilities and ethical practice
California tax law5State tax rules and California-specific treatment
Total20Annual continuing education

For the official breakdown, see CTEC’s CE standards.

Buying guide

Choosing an Online CTEC Renewal Course

Start with the way you prefer to learn. Video can help when you want an instructor to explain a concept. Text and downloadable materials can be useful when you want to read, search, or take notes. A printed book may suit you if you study away from a screen.

These features vary by provider. Compare the details that matter to you instead of choosing on the advertised price alone.

Before enrolling, check these details
Course access: When can you start, when does access expire, and can you resume where you left off?
Materials: Are videos, PDFs, printed books, and shipping included in the price?
Exams: What assessments are required, and what happens if you need another attempt?
Support: Can you reach someone when you normally study?
Reporting: How soon will the school report your completed hours to CTEC?
Total cost: Does a discount apply to the package you actually want?
Deadline

When Is the CTEC Renewal Deadline?

The standard CTEC renewal deadline is October 31. The renewal application opens August 1. For the current renewal season, plan to finish your education and renewal by October 31, 2026. CTEC allows late renewal through January 15; missing that final deadline means restarting the new-preparer process. See CTEC’s renewal guidance.

Allow time for the provider to report your education and for you to complete the renewal. Finishing the course and renewing your registration are separate steps.

Next steps

After You Complete Your Course

Save your completion certificate, confirm that your education appears in your CTEC account, and complete the remaining renewal requirements. Keep your tax preparer bond and IRS PTIN current. Course completion alone does not automatically renew your registration. Review the official CTEC renewal information before submitting.

Questions

CTEC 20 Hour Course Questions

Do I need the 20-hour or 60-hour course?

The 20-hour course is continuing education for registered preparers. People entering the CTEC registration process generally need qualifying education first. See the CTEC 60 hour course guide to compare that option.

Can I take a CTEC 20 hour course online?

Online options are available. Check whether the school uses text, video, live instruction, or a combination, and confirm that the course is approved for the credit you need.

How much does a CTEC renewal course cost?

Each provider sets its own price. Use the comparison directory to check published prices, then confirm the final amount with the school. Books, shipping, optional support, and package upgrades can change the total.

Does every course include unlimited exam attempts?

Do not assume that a feature offered by one school is included everywhere. Check the provider’s assessment and retake policy, including any fees, before enrolling.

How can I verify a school’s approval?

Search the school in the CTEC approved-provider directory and confirm its continuing education approval before paying.
